instruction: Design a system that combines the two given modules, twos_complement and barrel_shifter, along with an additional functional module that takes in the outputs of both modules and outputs the sum of their values. The twos_complement module takes in a 4-bit binary number and outputs its two's complement representation, while the barrel_shifter module implements a 4-bit barrel shifter with two inputs (DATA and SHIFT) and one output (OUT). The SHIFT input specifies the number of positions to shift the input data, with positive shifts shifting data to the left and negative shifts shifting data to the right. The system should have a synchronous reset input (RESET) that sets the output to 0 when high. The functional module should add the outputs of the twos_complement module and the barrel_shifter module, and output the final result.
label: clean
